updates.title: 🧸 Toy Box Smash Update: Platform fighting with your own avatar, slash trails and muzzle flashes
updates.text: Up to four fighters, percent cards with faces, Hero / Fighter / Gunner / Brawler styles, melee and ranged moves, custom slash colours.

updates.title: 🎃 Harbor Haunt Update: Bubble-pop chat sounds + your own alert tones
updates.text: Chat now pops softly as you type, send and receive, with a chime when someone says your name. Pick your own sounds in Start menu > Sounds.

updates.title: 🏍️ Garage Update: Ride your own bikes, in Oasis and Ryder X
updates.text: Import any bike model, size it, set the rider's seat, hands and feet. Other players see your ride. Animated GIFs now work as picture furniture.

updates.title: 🔨 Owner's Orders Update: Kick and ban from your own room
updates.text: Room owners can kick or ban players from their profile card. Log in straight into your Harbor Studio, or pick a default room in Decorate.

updates.title: 🔫 Gun Workshop Update: Swap any gun for your own model
updates.text: Replace each Gunner weapon with a custom model and fit it to the hand.
